description: Nora is caring for the late family garden and must decide how to handle a 30-kilogram tomato harvest, including what to freeze, what to pass along, and what to compost, after checking in with her brother and cousin.

shared_context.S1: The family's garden has produced 30 kilograms of ripe tomatoes that need to be handled this weekend.
shared_context.S2: Nora is coordinating the harvest plan and will make the final decision about preserving, sharing, and composting the tomatoes.
shared_context.S3: The tomatoes are currently in one set of crates at the garden, and the family wants to avoid letting usable food spoil.
shared_context.S4: Before settling the plan, Nora follows the family's usual kitchen check-in and asks everyone what they can store, take, or arrange.
shared_context.S5: Any tomatoes passed along must be sorted and packed on Saturday afternoon.

PF1.text: Eli has exactly 12 kilograms of free space in his chest freezer, and he can portion and label that amount on Saturday afternoon.

PF2.text: Sofia spoke with the coordinator of the Oak Street Community Fridge, who confirmed that it can accept exactly 10 kilograms of fresh tomatoes on Sunday between 09:00 and 11:00; this confirmation has not reached the family yet.

acceptance_conditions: All 30 kilograms must be assigned among frozen sauce, community-fridge donation, and compost.
Exactly 12 kilograms must be designated for frozen sauce.
Exactly 10 kilograms must be designated for the Oak Street Community Fridge.
Exactly 8 kilograms must be designated for compost.
The community-fridge delivery window must be Sunday from 09:00 to 11:00.
A commitment to portion and label the frozen sauce must exist.
A commitment to deliver the tomatoes to the Oak Street Community Fridge must exist.
Sofia's community-fridge confirmation must be cited as justification.

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF2' in revealed and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in credited_facts

decisive_facts.why: Eli's exact 12-kilogram freezer capacity changes the frozen-sauce amount from an arbitrary preservation quantity to 12 kilograms and makes the matching portioning commitment possible.
Sofia's confirmation changes the donation amount to exactly 10 kilograms, fixes delivery to Sunday 09:00-11:00, and supplies the specific community-fridge delivery commitment and cited justification.
